channel.title: Holistic Life: Strength Training at Home
channel.description: Strength Training at Home guides from Holistic Life.

item.title: Full Body Dumbbell Workout for Beginners: 2 Days a Week to Start
item.description: A full body dumbbell workout for beginners can start with two days a week. This guide shows a simple routine, how to pick your weight and when to add more. Calm, clear steps for first-timers. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Dumbbell Workout for Beginners at Home: 6 Moves With One Pair of Weights
item.description: A dumbbell workout for beginners at home using just one pair of weights. Six full-body moves, sets and reps, how to choose a starting weight and what to avoid. Plan two or three short sessions a week. Guide contains affiliate links.
